info.name: E-Commerce Multi-Vendor Backend API
info.description:
# E-Commerce Multi-Vendor Platform API

Complete API collection for the multi-vendor e-commerce backend built with Node.js, Express, TypeScript 7, PostgreSQL, Redis, and BullMQ.

## Features
- Multi-vendor marketplace
- Product catalog with variants
- Shopping cart and checkout
- Order management and tracking
- Payment integration (Razorpay)
- Review and rating system
- Wishlist functionality
- Commission and payout management
- Admin dashboard

## Getting Started
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Import the environment file
3. Set `baseUrl` to your API endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:3000)
4. Run the "Register" or "Login" request to get authentication token
5. Tokens are automatically stored and used in subsequent requests

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT authentication. The token is automatically:
- Stored after successful login/register
- Added to request headers
- Refreshed when needed

## Test Execution
You can run the entire collection using Collection Runner:
1. Open Collection Runner
2. Select this collection
3. Select the environment
4. Click "Run"

All tests will execute in sequence with proper data flow between requests.

## Admin Credentials (After Seeding)
- Email: admin@ecommerce.com
- Password: Admin@123

## Support
For issues or questions, refer to the project documentation.
